name: ICLR 2024 (CCF-A ML, OpenReview)
description: ICLR 2024 风格：无严格页限（推荐 8-10 页）、OpenReview 双盲、强调可解释性与 reproducibility checklist、理论+实证并重。

chapter_plan.title: Abstract
chapter_plan.prompt_role: 撰写 ICLR 风格摘要。
requirements: Strict <= 250 words
一句话问题、一句话缺口、一句话方法、一句话关键结果+不确定性、一句话验证指标
匿名：不写机构/作者/具体致谢线索

chapter_plan.title: 1 Introduction
requirements: Motivating example: 一个具体例子说明问题
Limitations of prior approaches: 明确不足
Our contributions: 用 bullet 列 3-4 个具体贡献（>=1 涉及因果识别/回测/网络层）
Paper organization

chapter_plan.title: 2 Related Work
requirements: 按主题聚类，非按时间

MUST engage systemic-risk network models (SDECM + DebtRank/NEVA), diffusion-spectral contagion, ABM/dynamic-graph contagion, system-dynamics housing models, empirical identification around implicit guarantees / central supervision
匿名：不泄露身份

chapter_plan.title: 3 Preliminaries
requirements: 符号表 + 必要背景（不重复教科书）
RIGOR: formalize all constructed quantities (e.g. 'land net income', policy multipliers) with reconciliation tables from raw inputs
Problem formulation

chapter_plan.title: 4 Method
requirements: Algorithm 1 / 2: 伪代码 + 复杂度
Mathematical formulation: 完整推导 + proof sketch（ICLR 重视 why it works）
RIGOR: causal identification or explicit identified-vs-assumed split; address endogeneity
RIGOR: hierarchical/panel structure for heterogeneity, not aggregates only
RIGOR: endogenous feedback loop (credit supply -> demand -> prices) with SVAR/structural justification
RIGOR: network loss-propagation layer (DebtRank / SDECM / diffusion-spectral PDE / TGNN) when systemic risk is central
RIGOR: document all parameter priors, distributions, correlations

chapter_plan.title: 5 Experiments
requirements: Setup: 数据集、baselines (>=5 incl. systemic-risk/network)、metric、硬件、种子数
RIGOR: out-of-sample backtest with RMSE/MAE/CRPS for key outcomes
RIGOR: ablation >=3 components; sensitivity tornado + elasticity to priors; heterogeneity decomposition
RIGOR: report std/CI over multiple seeds for ALL numbers
Intuition: 为什么每个组件 work（ICLR 特色）

chapter_plan.title: 6 Discussion
requirements: Limitations（必备，含 NPL recognition/restructuring/off-balance-sheet 未建模渠道）
Broader impact: positive + negative
Reproducibility statement

chapter_plan.title: 7 Conclusion
requirements: 总结核心 insight
未来工作

chapter_plan.title: References
requirements: authoryear 风格
30+ 引用

chapter_plan.title: Appendix
chapter_plan.prompt_role: 附录：证明/伪代码/超参数/数据集细节/复现清单。
requirements: 无页数限制
RIGOR: full code listing or repository URL
RIGOR: complete parameter priors / covariance matrix, distribution family per random parameter, correlations, random seeds
RIGOR: reconciliation tables for all constructed quantities from raw inputs
RIGOR: ICLR reproducibility checklist answers

system_prompt:
You are an expert ML researcher writing for ICLR 2024 (CCF-A, OpenReview, double-blind).

[FORMAT — STRICT]
- Use iclr2024_conference.sty (letterpaper, 11pt, single-column).
- No strict page limit (target 8-10 main pages); references and appendix excluded.
- Double-blind: no author names, affiliations, or self-identifying citations.
- Sections: Abstract -> 1 Introduction -> 2 Related Work -> 3 Preliminaries -> 4 Method -> 5 Experiments -> 6 Discussion -> 7 Conclusion -> References -> Appendix.

[ICLR EMPHASIS — reviewers prize 'why it works']
- Provide intuition for design choices; ablate to show each component's causal role.
- Reproducibility checklist in appendix (seeds, code, data, compute).
- Engage theoretical AND empirical reviewers — give a proof sketch even if empirical.

[RIGOR MANDATES — reject points]
- Causal identification or explicit identified-vs-assumed split; no pure linear calibration.
- Out-of-sample backtest with RMSE/MAE/CRPS.
- >=5 baselines incl. systemic-risk/network models (DebtRank/SDECM, diffusion-spectral, ABM) where relevant.
- Ablation >=3; sensitivity tornado; heterogeneity (hierarchical/panel).
- Endogenous feedback loops with SVAR/structural justification.
- Network loss-propagation layer when systemic risk is central.
- Formalize all constructed quantities with reconciliation tables.
- Release full code, parameter priors/covariances, distributions, correlations, seeds.

[OUTPUT FORMAT]
Return a single JSON object (no prose outside JSON) with keys: title, abstract, keywords (list[str]), latex_code, sections (dict[str, str]).

rigor_checklist: 必须提供因果识别或显式区分'已识别'与'假设'部分，处理内生性/反向因果
必须包含样本外回测/验证并报告 RMSE/MAE/CRPS
必须对比至少 5 个基线，含系统性风险/网络基线（DebtRank/SDECM、扩散谱、ABM）
必须做消融实验（>=3 个组件）与敏感性分析（tornado/结果对先验的弹性）
必须建模异质性（层级/面板结构），报告跨单元离散度，而非仅聚合
必须编码内生反馈环（如信贷供给->需求->价格），用 SVAR/结构块验证方向与量级
系统性风险为内核时必须加网络损失传染层（DebtRank/SDECM/扩散谱 PDE/TGNN）并与聚合块对比
必须形式化所有构造量（如'土地净收入'、政策乘数），给出原始输入到使用值的对账表
必须公开完整代码、参数先验/协方差、分布、相关性与随机种子
必须诚实陈述局限与 broader impact（正面+负面）
